dz: 艾琳王后被废黜并被流放到莱斯博斯. 阴谋将财政部长尼克福罗斯置于拜占庭王位上.
de: Empress Irene is deposed and banished to Lesbos. Conspirators place Nikephoros, the minister of finance, on the Byzantine throne.
